notes.title: v1.0.11 - 2023.3.4
notes.content:
v1.0.11 - 2023.3.4
- Fixed some wrong event triggers

v1.0.10 - 2023.2.27
- Appeased the overly enthusiastic goose

v1.0.9 - 2023.2.26
- Goose likes you more now.
- The second prompt for ending 4 is now more clear.
- Now there is no additional penalty when text speed is 0.
- Fixed the bug that the wrong reward would be entered if the game failed after 31 days.
- Fixed the bug that the performance was incorrect when restarting the game after watching ending 4.

v1.0.8 - 2023.2.23
- Fixed a bug with some text.

v1.0.7 - 2023.2.23
- Fixed a bug with some text.

v1.0.6 - 2023.2.23
- Fixed a bug where some texts were displayed incorrectly when the text speed was 0.

v1.0.5 - 2023.2.22
- Health are now easier to obtain.
- Now buffs with increased attributes will provide more bonuses.
- Fixed a bug with some text.

v1.0.4 - 2023.2.21
- Text is now shown momentarily when speed is at its lowest.
- Fixed the problem that some small performances could not be triggered correctly.
- Fixed a bug with some text.
